subject: Mutual Action Plan launch: Private/VPC deployment — ownership & topology
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Bryant <alice.bryant@nimblehealth.com>, ops@nimblehealth.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan launch: Private/VPC deployment — ownership & topology

Hi Alice / Nimble team,

Thanks for moving forward with the Private/VPC deployment — attached is the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.pdf) and a draft network diagram (network-diagram_v0.2.png). High-level asks for today:

- Confirm your networking lead and IP/CIDR constraints (VPN endpoints, NAT, public egress requirements).
- Confirm the IAM/KMS owner for key provisioning and whether you require HSM-backed keys.
- Agree topology: single-AZ with warm failover vs multi-AZ active-passive (we've sketched both in the diagram).
- Review the timeline in the MAP and flag any blockers for the proposed go-live: target week of 2027-04-11.

Requested next steps (ideally within 48 hours):
1) Introduce the network and security owners on this thread.
2) Share any procurement or compliance gating items (e.g., audit contacts, SOC2 evidence requests).
3) If you want us to run a short eval cluster before committing, tell us the representative workload and SLOs.

Links:
- MAP (editable): https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-Nimble-2027
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), network-diagram_v0.2.png (topology sketch), nimble_qs_completed.xlsx (preliminary questionnaire)

I'll volunteer to coordinate the first 2 weeks of the MAP. Marcus will take KMS/keys. Lauren will be the infra owner for deployment automation. Mina will lead role for customer success and cutover coordination.

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199
From: Alice Bryant <alice.bryant@nimblehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@nimblehealth.com, Mark Donovan <mark.donovan@nimblehealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan launch: Private/VPC deployment — ownership & topology

Thanks Rachel — excited to get this started.

Quick answers:
- Networking lead: Mark Donovan (mark.donovan@nimblehealth.com) — added him to cc.
- CIDR constraints: primary is 10.50.0.0/16; we'd prefer a policy to avoid public IPs for internal traffic. We can open a small NAT egress subnet if needed.
- KMS: security picks KMS via AWS KMS with HSM-backed keys; I'll loop our security lead if we need to share access details.

We should be able to return a short answers doc by EOD Tue 2027-03-02. For VPN params: we typically accept IKEv2/IPsec with public endpoint and pre-shared key or certificate. Can you propose your preferred termination? Also, please confirm whether Redwood needs inbound firewall rules from a fixed egress IP.

-Mark

I'll take point on KMS/KMS integration. Action items I propose:

- Mar 4: Agree on cert/key rotation window and access provisioning flow
- Mar 8: Test keywrap flow in evaluation cluster

Lauren — please confirm whether we should plan a two-node active-passive topology for initial eval (faster to stand up) or go straight to multi-AZ. I sketched a potential key-access flow in the attached diagram.

Ack — two quick items:
1) For speed, let's start with two-node active-passive for the eval cluster; we can expand to multi-AZ for production.
2) On cert rotation and HSM: if Nimble requires HSM-backed KMS, we'll need a short SLA on key import and a contact who can approve HSM access (security contact). Marcus, I can prepare the deployment automation repo and tests by Mar 5.

I'll add an internal runbook link in the MAP doc. 

Lauren
